Corundum · Oxide

Ruby

Corundum · Oxide

Sapphire

Iron and titanium weave the classic blue. The same mineral as ruby — every color except red.

Beryl · Silicate

Emerald

Chromium and vanadium green the queen of beryl. Jardin inclusions tell stories of deep formation.

Quartz · Silicate

Amethyst

Irradiated iron gives quartz its royal violet. Ancient Greeks believed it guarded against drunkenness.

Mohs7SystemTrigonalOriginBrazil

Diamond

Pure carbon at Mohs 10. Born 150 km deep — volcanic pipes carry the hardest gem to the surface.

Photo ID · Vision AI

Identify a Rock

Upload or snap a photo of a gemstone, crystal, or rock from your collection. Lithos uses vision AI to suggest what it might be — with hardness, chemistry, origin hints, and care tips. Results link to the catalog when we find a match.

Rock identification needs a site AI key — same setup as the Gold Rock Teacher on Classes.

Add window.LITHOS_AI_CONFIG in ai-config.js with your Gemini (or OpenAI-compatible) API key, then reload.

AI guesses from a photo — not a lab test. Uncertain IDs are flagged. Always handle unknown minerals with care.

Secret Cheat Codes

Enter a code

Got a secret code? Type it in to unlock special powers! Only real codes work — try to find them all!

Secret codes unlock special powers — including one that makes you the owner of the whole game. Paid for a membership? Try your receipt code (e.g. SILVER99).

Weaponary codes unlock Motion Battlefield gear — weapons, shields, powers, and avatars in the Gem Armory. Owner-tier codes need owner status or the correct weaponary code.

Code breaker (try code breaker) unlocks the glitched arena pack and ⚡ Glitch Claw, Glitch Shield, Glitch Burst & Glitched Aura in the Gem Armory. Rainbow unlocks the Gem Warrior God and 🌈 Rainbow Blade, Rainbow Shield, Rainbow Burst & Rainbow Gem avatar.

Owner TV — private video platform (owner code required).

Power Up Your Warriors

Choose an aura

Auras give your warriors a big boost! Each one multiplies your health and attack power. Tap one to equip it — then battle!

Auras are for the game owner. Enter the owner code in Secret Codes to unlock all auras. For now you can battle with No Aura.

Your equipped aura works on every warrior in battle. The Black Diamond Void aura is the most powerful of all.

Optional · separate checkout

Tip the Lithos maker

Pact gifts and maker tips are two separate checkouts — nothing auto-splits. If you’d like, tip Graham (~10%-style small thank-you amounts). Totally optional.

Pact gifts open Pact’s official donation page (Network for Good). Pick your amount there — a grown-up should complete checkout. Pact funds work worldwide, including responsible mining programs.

Maker tips open a separate Founders Weekends checkout for Graham (who built Lithos). They do not go to Pact. Choosing both means two payments: one to Pact, one tip to the maker.

Disclaimer: the gemstone pictures and names on these donation cards (hematite, garnet, ruby, sapphire, emerald, amethyst, tanzanite, diamond) are just fun labels for each gift amount — you are not buying a gemstone.
